description.value: Shawnigan Lake Beach Resort is a privately owned and operated lakefront condo resort on six and a half acres along Shawnigan Lake on Vancouver Island, about 30 minutes north of Victoria. It is the only beach-side resort on the lake, offering direct beach access, watercraft mooring, an indoor pool, and a range of lawn and court sports. Accommodations are individually owner-managed condos, each fully self-contained with a kitchen and private deck with barbecue.
